Raw SCIP index rows

Usage: ryi scip [OPTIONS] [PATH]...

Arguments:
  [PATH]...  Files, directories, or globs; - reads a path list from stdin

Options:
      --pattern <GLOB>       Keep files matching GLOB under each directory input; repeatable
      --entry <FILE>         Run on the files FILE reaches over imports (universe: the PATH inputs, else FILE's project)
      --depth <N>            Import hops from --entry
      --root <DIR>           Corpus root
      --sqlite <PATH>        Write to a new SQLite database instead of stdout
      --lines                Add 1-based line/col beside every span
      --scip-index <FILE>    Load this index.scip instead of finding or building one
      --scip-cache <DIR>     SCIP index cache directory
      --scip-timeout <SECS>  Seconds allowed for one indexer run
      --indexer <LANG>       Run only this language's SCIP indexer
      --raw                  Stream the index records themselves instead of the scip_* relations
      --records <KINDS>      Only these --raw record kinds (comma-separated)
      --occurrence-text      Add the source text to each scip_occurrence
      --scip-build           Build the index for --raw with the inputs' language indexer
  -h, --help                 Print help
